finding: Unknown public URLs return HTTP 200 homepage instead of 404
evidence: Missing root, article and car paths return 200, homepage H1, canonical /; technical/missing-paths.json and technical/summary.json
impact: Soft-404 handling wastes crawl effort and obscures broken links; not proof of an indexing block on existing pages.
fix: Return actual 404/410 for unknown public routes while retaining explicit legacy WebApp routes.

finding: English documents declare Russian html language
evidence: 55 EN sitemap URLs have html lang=ru; rendered EN home and winter article remain ru after hydration.
impact: Wrong document language affects assistive technology and language handling; not proof Google cannot detect English.
fix: Emit html lang=en in English server HTML and verify hydrated DOM.

finding: Both homepages omit Open Graph image and type
evidence: / and /en/ have no og:image or og:type; twitter:image exists. baseline/social_meta.json and content/REPORT.md.
impact: Social share previews may lack expected image/type; not an indexing blocker.
fix: Add website type and an existing absolute preview image URL to both homepages.

finding: English homepage Twitter metadata is Russian
evidence: /en/ twitter:title is Аренда авто и байков на Пхукете; English title and OG metadata otherwise localized.
fix: Localize Twitter title and description along with Open Graph.

finding: Russian reviews article description repeats its heading without a useful summary
evidence: /articles/choose-car-rental-phuket-reviews/ meta description equals Как выбрать прокатчика на Пхукете по отзывам.
impact: Missed opportunity for a useful search/share summary; engines may rewrite snippets.
fix: Provide a specific summary of how the guide helps compare reviews and rental terms.

finding: Homepage lacks six common security response headers
evidence: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy absent; baseline/security_headers.json, confirmed curl HEAD.
impact: Security hardening opportunity, not direct evidence of ranking loss.
fix: Plan tested security headers with Telegram/iframe/embed compatibility; stage CSP report-only and HSTS only after HTTPS coverage review.

finding: Mobile article cards download full-size source images
evidence: 390px index transfers winter cover 240648 bytes and car photo 234484 bytes; browser/browser-results.json.
impact: Avoidable mobile transfer; actual user speed impact needs field/lab testing.
fix: Generate smaller responsive variants and verify browser-selected source sizes.

finding: Sampled navigation does not expose business identity and privacy destinations beyond Telegram
evidence: 13-page sample links to Telegram bot or manager, no about/privacy/tel/mail/map links found; not a whole-site absence claim.
impact: Readers may struggle to identify the responsible company and personal-data handling.
fix: Verify existing pages and expose truthful operator/contact/privacy information without fabricated addresses or credentials.

finding: Real-user Core Web Vitals remain unknown
evidence: PageSpeed mobile returned API HTTP400; no Search Console or CrUX data. Browser timings are unthrottled diagnostics only.
impact: Cannot conclude performance passes or fails Google field thresholds.
fix: Retrieve PSI/CrUX or authorized Search Console data and run repeatable mobile lab tests.
